pinning_model.ci_linux: Pinned by (dated CRAN snapshot + exact version). CI installs from the snapshot below and then verifies the INSTALLED version of every package in this file against `version`, failing closed on any absence or difference. A Windows binary SHA-256 is NOT used, and does not authenticate, the Linux installation.
pinning_model.local_windows: Pinned by (version + SHA-256 of the CRAN Windows binary). Those hashes are platform-specific and authenticate only the Windows install on the developer workstation.
pinning_model.not_claimed: This lockfile does not claim byte-level authentication of the Linux packages. It claims exact version pinning, enforced by a CI check over every package listed here.
